sections.title: Introduction to Professionalism, Community and Patient Management
sections.description: The course will provide foundational knowledge on the doctor patient relationship, medical history skills and the basics of dental orofacial physical exam and developing the doctor patient relationship. Students will receive instruction about the principles of professionalism and ethical decision making through case-based discussions.
